title: Privacy Policy - Zum
content:
Children Related Data Collection

Our Services are applicable to children from 5- 15 years of age. As a user, if you (parent or person authorized by parent)register a child as a family member (collectively termed as “user” henceforth), we’ll request that you provide us with certain information (including PII) that can be used to identify such person, such as name, photo, age, phone number, and email address. In the event the user is a child under the age of 13, by providing such information about the child, you affirm that you are such child’s parent or guardian and have all requisite authority to provide us with such information and to authorize us to use such information. In order to provide your Rides and Services, you also acknowledge that, as noted above, we will pass certain of this information on to the Zumers who provide your Rides and Services. Zumers will have access to a Zum-provided phone number to allow the Zumers to communicate with such users, including users who are children (however, the user’s actual phone number will not be provided directly to the Zumer), the user’s first name and last name, photo, schedule. Zumers will be able to communicate directly with user, including children under the age of 13, over the course of providing a Ride or Service, via voice call and/or text message (through a masked phone number, and not the user’s actual phone number), as well as through in-person communication. Other detailed data collection and its use by us is appended below.

Information Directly Provided By User

Zum collects information that our users provide directly to us over web, mobile app, email, phone call or text or in person through Zumers. This information can be collected during various interactions such as when user creates or modifies their account, request on-demand services, contact customer support, or otherwise communicate with us directly or indirectly. This information may include: name, email, phone number, postal address, profile picture, payment method, service notes, and other information user choose to provide about self or user’s family, friends and social network (such as about user’s connections, user’s kids’ school or activity centers/staff, neighbors and their families, etc).

Information Collected From User’s Use Of Our Services

When user use our Services, Zum collect information about user in the following other ways:

Location Information: When user uses Zum rides and services, Zum collect precise location data about the rides and services from the Zum app used by the Zumer. If user permit the Zum app to access location services through the permission system used by user’s mobile operating system (“platform”), Zum may also collect the precise location of user’s device when the app is running in the foreground or background. Zum may also derive user’s approximate location from user’s IP address.

Contacts Information: If user permit the Zum app to access the address book on user’s device through the permission system used by user’s mobile platform, Zum may access and store names and contact information from user’s address book to facilitate social interactions through our Services and for other purposes described in this Statement or at the time of consent or collection.

Transaction Information: Zum collect transaction details related to user’s use of our Services, including the type of service requested, date and time the service was provided, amount charged, distance traveled, and other related transaction details. Additionally, if someone uses user’s promo code, Zum may associate user’s name with that person.

Usage and Preference Information: Zum collect information about how user and site visitors interact with our Services, preferences expressed, and settings chosen. In some cases Zum do this through the use of cookies, pixel tags, and similar technologies that create and maintain unique identifiers. Details about this is in our Cookie Statement.

Device Information: Zum may collect information about user’s mobile device, including, for example, the hardware model, operating system and version, software and file names and versions, preferred language, unique device identifier, advertising identifiers, serial number, device motion information, and mobile network information.

Call and SMS Data: Our Services facilitate communications between Users and Zumers. In connection with facilitating this service, Zum receive call data, including the date and time of the call or SMS message, the parties’ phone numbers, and the content of the SMS message.

Log Information: When user interact with the Services, Zum collect server logs, which may include information like device IP address, access dates and times, app features or pages viewed, app crashes and other system activity, type of browser, and the third-party site or service user were using before interacting with our Services.

Important Information About Platform Permissions

Most mobile platforms (iOS, Android, etc.) have defined certain types of device data that apps cannot access without user’s consent. And these platforms have different permission systems for obtaining user’s consent. The iOS platform will alert user the first time the Zum app wants permission to access certain types of data and will let user consent (or not consent) to that request. Android devices will notify user of the permissions that the Zum app seeks before user first use the app, and user’s use of the app constitutes user’s consent.

Information Zum Collects From Other Sources

Zum may also receive information from other sources and combine that with information Zum collect through our Services. For example:

If user choose to link, create, or log in to user’s Zum account with a payment provider (e.g., Google Wallet) or social media service (e.g., Facebook), or if user engage with a separate app or website that uses our API (or whose API Zum use), Zum may receive information about user or user’s connections from that site or app.

If user’s affiliation uses one of our enterprise solutions, Zum may receive information about user from user’s affiliate (affiliate can be user’s employee, school, activity centers, etc).
When user request Zum services, our Zumers may provide us with a User rating after providing services to user.

If user also interact with our Services in another capacity, for instance as a Zumer or user of other apps Zum provides, Zum may combine or associate that information with information Zum have collected from user in user’s capacity as a User or rider.

Use of Information

Zum may use the information Zum collect about user to:

Provide, maintain, and improve our Services, including, for example, match between user and Zumer, create pool rides, facilitate payments, send receipts, provide products and services user request (and send related information), develop new features, provide customer support to Users and Zumers, develop safety features, authenticate users, and send product updates and administrative messages;

Perform internal operations, including, for example, to prevent fraud and abuse of our Services; to troubleshoot software bugs and operational problems; to conduct data analysis, testing, and research; and to monitor and analyze usage and activity trends;
Send or facilitate communications (i) between user and a Zumer, such as estimated times of arrival (ETAs), or (ii) between user and a contact of user at user’s direction in connection with user’s use of certain features, such as referrals, invites, split fare requests, or ETA sharing;

Send user communications Zum think will be of interest to user, including information about products, services, promotions, news, and events of Zum and other companies, where permissible and according to local applicable laws; and to process contest, sweepstake, or other promotion entries and fulfill any related awards;

Personalize and improve the Services, including to provide or recommend features, content, social connections, referrals, and advertisements.

Sharing of Information

Zum may share the information Zum collect about user as described in this Statement or as described at the time of collection or sharing, including as follows:

Through Our Services

Zum may share user’s information:

With Zumers to enable them to provide the Services user request. For example, Zum share user’s name, photo (if user provide one), average User rating given by Zumers, and pickup and/or drop-off locations with Zumers;

With other riders if user use a ride-sharing service like Pool ride; and with other people, as directed by user, such as when user want to share user’s estimated time of arrival or split a fare with a friend;

With third parties to provide user a service user requested through a partnership or promotional offering made by a third party or us;

With the general public if user submit content in a public forum, such as blog comments, social media posts, or other features of our Services that are viewable by the general public;

With third parties with whom user choose to let us share information, for example other apps or websites that integrate with our API or Services, or those with an API or Service with which Zum integrate; and

With user’s affiliates (affiliate can be user’s employee, school, activity centers, etc) and any necessary third parties engaged by us or user’s affiliates, if user participate in any of our enterprise solutions.

Other Important Sharing

Zum may share user’s information:

With Zum subsidiaries and affiliated entities that provide services or conduct data processing on our behalf, or for data centralization and / or logistics purposes;

With vendors, consultants, marketing partners, and other service providers who need access to such information to carry out work on our behalf;

In response to a request for information by a competent authority if Zum believe disclosure is in accordance with, or is otherwise required by, any applicable law, regulation, or legal process;

With law enforcement officials, government authorities, or other third parties if Zum believe user’s actions are inconsistent with our User agreements, Terms of Service, or policies, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Zum or others;

In connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, consolidation or restructuring, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by or into another company;

If Zum otherwise notify user and user consent to the sharing; and

In an aggregated and/or anonymized form which cannot reasonably be used to identify user.

Social Sharing Features

The Services may integrate with social sharing features and other related tools which let user share actions user take on our Services with other apps, sites, or media, and vice versa. User’s use of such features enables the sharing of information with user’s friends or the public, depending on the settings user establish with the social sharing service. Please refer to the privacy policies of those social sharing services for more information about how they handle the data user provide to or share through them.

Analytics and Advertising Services Provided by Others

Zum may allow others to provide audience measurement and analytics services for us, to serve advertisements on our behalf across the Internet, and to track and report on the performance of those advertisements. These entities may use cookies, web beacons, SDKs, and other technologies to identify user’s device when user visit our site and use our Services, as well as when user visit other online sites and services. “Cookies” are small text files that are placed on your hard drive by a Web server when you access our Services. We may use both session Cookies and persistent Cookies to identify that you’ve logged in to the Services and to tell us how and when you interact with our Services. We may also use Cookies to monitor aggregate usage and web traffic routing on our Services and to customize and improve our Services. Unlike persistent Cookies, session Cookies are deleted when you log off from the Services and close your browser. Although most browsers automatically accept Cookies, you can change your browser options to stop automatically accepting Cookies or to prompt you before accepting Cookies. Please note, however, that if you don’t accept Cookies, you may not be able to access all portions or features of the Services. Some third-party services providers that we engage (including third-party advertisers) may also place their own Cookies on your hard drive. Note that this Privacy Policy covers only our use of Cookies and does not include use of Cookies by such third parties.

“Web Beacons” (also known as clear gifs) are tiny graphics with a unique identifier that may be included on our Services for several purposes, including to deliver or communicate with Cookies, to track and measure the performance of our Services, to monitor how many visitors view our Services, and to monitor the effectiveness of our advertising. Unlike Cookies, which are stored on the user’s hard drive, Web Beacons are typically embedded invisibly on web pages (or in an e-mail).
